S2E24c4-L2.mt: አወ! ታውቃለህ ለዛ ሳይሆን አይቀርም ህጻናት ማውራት የሚማሩት ስለዚህ አዋቂዎቹ እንዲቆርጡ ሊነግሩ ይችላሉ።
S2E24c4-L2.back: Oh, you know, maybe that's why children learn to talk so they can tell adults to stop.

S2E24c4-L21.mt: በጣም ጥሩ ነው። አሁን ስለዚህ ጉዳይ ማውራት እንደማንፈልግ ታውቃለህ። በእውነቱ፣ እኔ የምለው ይህ ነው፣ መንገድ፣ መንገድ፣ መንገድ ነው፣ ወደፊት፣ እኔ እያወራሁ ነው ማንዣበብ እና ዝንጀሮዎች ፕላኔቷን እየተቆጣጠሩ።
S2E24c4-L21.back: Very good. You know we don't want to talk about it now. Actually, this is what I'm saying, way, way, way, forward, I'm talking about boom and monkeys controlling the planet.

S2E24c4-L3.mt: ሄይ፣ ለአንተ ጥያቄ እንዳለኝ ታውቃለህ። ትንሽ ነገር ፣ ምንም ግፊት የለም።
S2E24c4-L3.back: Hey, you know I have a question for you. A little thing, no pressure.

S2E24c4-L9.mt: አምላክ ሆይ፣ አንተ በጣም እድለኛ ልትሆን ነው።

S2E2c2-L17.mt: ና፣ ከጁሊ ጋር ወደ Bloomingdale's ይሄዳሉ? ራሄልን በአምልኮ ቤቷ እንደማታለል ነው።
S2E2c2-L17.back: So, you're going to Bloomingdale's with Julie? It's like cheating Rachel in her church.

S2E2c2-L19.mt: ሞኒካ፣ ትገድልሃለች። መንገድ ላይ እንደ ውሻ ትገድልሃለች።
S2E2c2-L19.back: Monica, she'll kill you. She'll kill you like a dog on the road.

S2E2c2-L22.mt: ለእኔ ትልቅ ጉዳይ ነው። ይህ በጣም ጥሩ ነው, ሞኒካ. ይህንን በጣም አደንቃለሁ።
S2E2c2-L22.back: It's a big deal for me. This is very good, Monica. I really appreciate it.

S2E2c2-L6.mt: አመሰግናለሁ። ምን አይነት ሴት ዉሻ ነዉ።

S2E2c2-L7.mt: ኦህ፣ እናንተ ሰዎች ስሙ። ነገ የሚያቆመው ይህ የ Bloomingdale ጓደኛ አለኝ እና ቅናሹን አላግባብ መጠቀም ይፈልጋል። ስለዚህ ማንም ከእኔ ጋር መጥቶ መጠቀም ይፈልጋል?
S2E2c2-L7.back: Oh, listen, you guys. I have this Bloomingdale friend who stops tomorrow and wants to abuse the discount. So anyone wants to come and use it with me?

S2E2c2-L8.mt: አልችልም ፣ አያቴን ወደ የእንስሳት ሐኪም ዘንድ መውሰድ አለብኝ።
S2E2c2-L8.back: I can't, I have to take my grandpa to the vet.

S3E11c11-L10.mt: ትክክል ጥሩ ነገር ነው፣ ያ ነው ያልኩት።
S3E11c11-L10.back: Right, it's a good thing, that's what I meant.

S3E11c11-L18.mt: አዎ፣ ማርክን ካወቅኩት፣ እና የማውቀው ከሆነ፣ ምንም ያነሰ ነገር አልጠብቅም።
S3E11c11-L18.back: Yes, since I know Mark, and I know him, I don't expect anything less.

S3E11c11-L20.mt: ከፍተኛ አንገትጌ እና ቦርሳ ያለው ሱሪ ፕሮፌሽናል ነኝ ይላሉ።
S3E11c11-L20.back: The high-neck and handbag saree says I'm a professional.

S3E11c11-L24.mt: 'ለምን አትደውይለትም?!' ደህና ፣ በጣም አመሰግናለሁ! የወንድ ጓደኛውን በቀዶ ስታወጡት እንደምታደርጉት አሁን እሱ እንደሚያሰናዳላት ታውቃላችሁ።
S3E11c11-L24.back: 'Why don't you call him?!' Okay, thank you very much! You know, like you do when you surgically remove her boyfriend's hair, he's going to talk to her now.

S3E11c11-L26.mt: እኔ ነኝ! እኔ ነኝ! ከአእምሮዬ ወጥቻለሁ! አእምሮዬ እየጠፋኝ ነው!! ይህ ህልም ያለው ሰው የሴት ጓደኛዬን ለምግብ እየወሰደ ነው።
S3E11c11-L26.back: It's me! It's me! I'm out of my mind! I'm losing my mind!! This dreamer is taking my girlfriend out for lunch!

S3E11c11-L3.mt: አዎ፣ ትክክል። ተመልከተህ፣ በተግባር ጎበዝ ነህ።
S3E11c11-L3.back: Yeah, that's right. Look, you're a man of action.

S3E11c11-L4.mt: አይ፣ የማርቆስ ነገር ባለመሳካቱ ከልብ አዝናለሁ። ተመልከት ራች ለአንተ ጥሩ ነገር ብቻ ነው የምፈልገው።
S3E11c11-L4.back: No, I'm really sorry that Mark's thing didn't work out. Look Rach, I only want good things for you.

S3E11c11-L8.mt: ምን፣ የቤት ቁጥሩን ሰጠህ? ልክ እንደ, ወደ, ወደ ቤቱ?
S3E11c11-L8.back: What, you gave the house number?

S3E11c11-L9.mt: አዎ፣ እና ብጠራ ምንም ችግር የለህም፣ ምክንያቱም የምትፈልገው ለእኔ ጥሩ ነገር ብቻ ነው።
S3E11c11-L9.back: Yes, and if I call you, you don't have to worry, because you only want good things for me.

S3E12c1-L12.back: You must go to the end to get your keys.

S3E12c1-L15.mt: አይ፣ አይ፣ አይ፣ ምንም ኤሊዎች አያስፈሩኝም። ዛሬ ያንን አያስፈልገኝም።
S3E12c1-L15.back: No, no, no, no elves scare me. I don't need that today.

S3E12c1-L2.mt: ኦህ አዎ፣ ግን አትጨነቅ። ያንን ፎጣ ልብስ እስካልበስክ ድረስ ማንም ሰው በዚያ ላይ የሚያተኩር አይመስለኝም።
S3E12c1-L2.back: Oh yeah, but don't worry. I don't think anyone's going to focus on it until you wear that bag.

S3E12c1-L20.mt: ኧረ አይደለም ቦርሳ ነው። እና በውስጡ ቴርሞስ አለ.
S3E12c1-L20.back: Oh, no, it's a bag. And it has a thermos inside.

S3E12c1-L24.mt: በእርግጥ አልበርት ምንም ጓደኞች የሉትም። ስለ ባችለር ፓርቲ ግን በጣም ጓጉቷል። እኔ እንደማስበው የሚያገባበት ብቸኛው ምክንያት ገላጣን ማየት እንዲችል ነው።
S3E12c1-L24.back: Of course Albert has no friends, but he is very excited about the bachelor party. I think the only reason he is going to marry is to be able to see the flames.

S3E12c1-L25.mt: በባችለር ፓርቲ ላይ የሚራቆት ፣ ያ በጣም ክሊች ነው። ለምን አስማተኛ አታገኝም?!
S3E12c1-L25.back: A bachelorette party, that's a cliché. Why don't you get a bachelorette?!

S3E12c1-L26.mt: ደህና፣ አስማተኛው ቢራዬን በጉንጮቹ ቢከፍትልኝ፣ ደህና።
S3E12c1-L26.back: Okay, if the thief opens my beer with his knuckles, fine.

S3E12c1-L4.mt: በዚህ አዲስ ሥራ የመጀመሪያዋ ቀን ነው። ከእሷ ጋር መጀመር የለብዎትም!
S3E12c1-L4.back: This is the first day of this new job. You shouldn't start with it!

S3E12c1-L5.mt: እሺ፣ አንድ ቀን መጠበቅ እንደምችል እገምታለሁ። ሄይ፣ አርብ ምን እየሰራህ ነው?
S3E12c1-L5.back: Okay, I guess I can wait a day. Hey, what are you doing Friday?

S3E12c1-L9.back: Ah. Is that a dinosaur skeleton?

S3E4c6-L10.mt: እንኳን ወደ ዋሻው ጎናችን በደህና መጡ።

S3E4c6-L11.mt: በነገራችን ላይ ይህ አይስክሬም ልክ እንደ ቆሻሻ ነው።
S3E4c6-L11.back: By the way, this ice cream is just like garbage.

S3E4c6-L12.mt: አዎ፣ ያ የአካባቢ፣ ወተት ያልሆነ፣ የአኩሪ አተር ወተት ቆሻሻ ነው። ለእነዚያ በጣም የመጨረሻ ለሆኑ ጉዳዮች እውነተኛውን ነገር እናስቀምጣለን።
S3E4c6-L12.back: Yes, that's environmental, non-dairy, cow's milk waste. We'll keep the real thing for those very last things.

S3E4c6-L13.mt: ታውቃላችሁ፣ ሁል ጊዜ መፍጨት ሲጀምሩ ወደ ዝቅተኛ ስብ መቀየር አለብዎት።
S3E4c6-L13.back: You know, you always have to switch to low fat when you start to melt.

S3E4c6-L15.mt: ታዲያ እኔ ተርሚናል ነኝ ብለህ አታስብም?
S3E4c6-L15.back: So you don't think I'm a terminal?

S3E4c6-L16.mt: ደህና፣ አይ፣ በጭራሽ፣ እርስዎ ተርሚናል አይደሉም፣ እርስዎ ብቻ፣ የተወሰነ የጉዳት ቁጥጥር ብቻ ያስፈልግዎታል።
S3E4c6-L16.back: Well, no, not at all, you're not a terminal, you're just yourself, you just need some damage control.

S3E4c6-L19.mt: አሁን በጣም ወሳኝ ጊዜ ነው። ያንን ስልክ ለማግኘት እራስህ እንደደረስክ ከተሰማህ ጫማ ገብተሃል፣ ቂጥህን በአረፋ መታጠቢያ ታገኛለህ። እሷን እንድትመልስ ትፈልጋለህ ራቅ ብለህ መስራት መጀመር አለብህ።
S3E4c6-L19.back: This is a very critical time. If you feel like you've come to get that phone yourself, you've got your shoes on, you've got your shit in the washbasin. You want to get her back, you have to start working from a distance.

S3E4c6-L2.mt: ስለዚህ በመጨረሻ አገኘኋት እና ይህ ግንኙነት በፍጥነት እንደሚሄድ እና ፍጥነት መቀነስ አለብን ብላለች።
S3E4c6-L2.back: So I finally met her and she said this relationship is going fast and we should slow down.

S3E4c6-L21.mt: ትክክል። ስለዚህ, ማድረግ ያለብዎት, ሆን ብለው በድንገት ወደ እርሷ መሮጥ አለብዎት. እና ከዚያ ዘና ይበሉ።
S3E4c6-L21.back: That's right. So, all you have to do, is intentionally run to her suddenly. And then relax.

S3E4c6-L23.mt: ኦህ ፣ ማር ፣ ሙሉ በሙሉ ተሸናፊ አይደለህም ።
S3E4c6-L23.back: Oh , Mary , you 're not a complete loser .

S3E4c6-L24.back: And I said, 'So I didn't lose it?'

S3E4c6-L5.mt: ከዚያም ችግረኛ እና የሙጥኝ ያሉ ሁሉ አገኘሁ።
S3E4c6-L5.back: Then I found all the needy and destitute.

S1E16c15-L11.mt: እኔ እሷ ክፉ ነች እያልኩ አይደለም። እሷ ግን ሁሌም እቃዬን ትሰብራለች። የስምንት ዓመት ልጅ ሳለሁ የካርቱን ቴርሞስ እንዲኖራት ስላልፈቀድኩላት በአውቶቡስ ስር ወረወረችው። እና ከዚያም ራንዲ ብራውን ነበር. የቅርብ ጓደኛህ የሆነ የወንድ ጓደኛ ኖት ታውቃለህ?
S1E16c15-L11.back: I'm not saying she's evil, but she always smashes my stuff. When I was seven years old, she threw it under the bus because I didn't let her have a thermos. And then there was Randy Brown. You know that boyfriend who was your closest friend?

S1E16c15-L13.mt: እሱ ለእኔ እሱ ነበር። ከእኔ ወስዳ ልቡን ሰበረችው። ከዚያም ሁለታችንንም የሚመስል ሰው መቅረብ ስለማይፈልግ ከእኔ ጋር ማውራት አቆመ።
S1E16c15-L13.back: She took him away from me and broke his heart. Then he stopped talking to me because he didn't want to get close to someone who looked like us both.

S1E16c15-L15.mt: ጆይ የወንድ ጓደኛዬ እንዳልሆነ አውቃለሁ ነገር ግን...
S1E16c15-L15.back: I know Joey isn't my boyfriend, but...

S1E16c15-L21.mt: ለአንድ ሳምንት ያህል ተዋውቀዋል። እስካሁን የግብረ ሥጋ ግንኙነት አልፈጸሙም። ያ ከባድ አይደለም።
S1E16c15-L21.back: They've known each other for about a week. They haven't had sex yet. That's not hard.

S1E16c15-L3.mt: እሷ በጥሩ ሁኔታ ወሰደችው። ከስቴፕለር ክስተት በስተቀር። አንዳንድ ምክሮች እዚህ አሉ: ተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ ካጋጠመዎት, እጅዎን በጠረጴዛው ላይ በጭራሽ አይተዉት.
S1E16c15-L3.back: She took it well. Except for the stapler incident. Here are some tips: If the same thing happens to you, never leave your hand on the table.

S1E22c5-L18.mt: አትከፋ። በፊት ወደዱህ። ግን ከዚያ ከፍ ከፍ ብለሃል፣ እና አሁን ሚስተር ቦስ ማን፣ ቦስ ማን ቢንግ ይሉሃል።
S1E22c5-L18.back: Don't be bad. They liked you before. But then you got higher and higher, and now you're called Mr. Boss Man, Boss Man Bing.

S1E22c5-L20.back: They will even be proud of you.

S1E22c5-L22.mt: ልክ እንደዚህ፡- 'ያ ሪፖርት በኋላ ሊሆን ይችላል?'
S1E22c5-L22.back: Just like this:- 'Can the report be later?'

S1E22c5-L26.back: 'The mountains were alive in the sound of music.'

S1E22c5-L29.mt: እኔ እንደዛ አይሰማኝም። ይህ እውነት አይደለም.
S1E22c5-L29.back: I don't feel like that. It's not true.

S1E22c5-L4.mt: ሰላም፣ አንድ ገጽ ደረሰኝ። አይ፣ አንድሬ እዚህ የለም። ዛሬ ለሦስተኛ ጊዜ ነው። አይ ጌታዬ እነዚያን አገልግሎቶች አልሰጥም።
S1E22c5-L4.back: Hello, I received a page. No, Andrew is not here. It's the third time today. No, my Lord, I don't provide those services.

S1E22c5-L6.mt: ቁጥር 55-JUMBO ይፈልጋሉ። እመኑኝ አትፈልጉኝም። በእሱ ቁጥር ላይ በመመስረት, በእኔ ላይ በጣም ታዝናላችሁ. በህና ሁን።
S1E22c5-L6.back: You don’t want me, believe me. Based on his number, you’ll be very sorry for me.

S1E22c5-L9.back: See, it helps to know me.

S2E21c5-L11.mt: ሶፋውን ትጠራላችሁ, ሶፋውን እንጠራዋለን, እና ወደ የትኛው ቡድን እንደሚሄድ እናያለን.
S2E21c5-L11.back: You call the couch, we call the couch, and we'll see which team it goes to.

S2E21c5-L25.mt: ወደ ውጭ ውጣ እና ተዋጉ? ማነው እንደዚህ ያወራው?
S2E21c5-L25.back: Go out and fight? Who says that?

S2E21c5-L26.back: That's what the one who wants to hit you says.

S2E21c5-L3.mt: እነዚያን ጃኬቶች ለመልበስ የንብረት ተወካይ መሆን አለቦት?
S2E21c5-L3.back: Must be a property representative to wear those jackets?

S2E21c5-L30.mt: ከዚያ ወደዚህ ቡና ቤት እንደገና ካልተመለሱ መዋጋት የለብዎትም።
S2E21c5-L30.back: Then you don't have to fight unless you come back to this cafe again.

S2E21c5-L31.mt: ጉንተርን ለእርዳታ የጠየቁት በጣም ቀደም ብለው ይመስለኛል።
S2E21c5-L31.back: I think they asked Gunther for help a long time ago.

S2E21c5-L5.back: Isn't he the one wearing your hat?

S2E24c4-L12.mt: አንዳንድ ጊዜ የሕክምና ልምዴን ስለመሸጥ አስባለሁ። ወደ ፈረንሳይ ተዛውረን የፈረንሳይ ቶስት ማድረግ እንችላለን።
S2E24c4-L12.back: Sometimes I think about selling my medical experience. We could move to France and make a French toast.

S2E24c4-L13.mt: ፈረንሳይ ውስጥ ነን እና ቶስት እየሰራን ነው። አንድ ትንሽ የሕፃን አልጋ ጥግ ላይ ታያለህ?
S2E24c4-L13.back: We're in France and we're making toast. Can you see a little one on the side of a baby's bed?

S2E24c4-L15.back: A female is not a dog, but a baby bed.

S2E24c4-L17.mt: ሕፃኑ ከውሻው ላይ ይወድቃል ብዬ አስባለሁ. በወደፊታችን ልጆችን አያዩም?
S2E24c4-L17.back: I think the baby will fall from the dog.

S2E24c4-L2.mt: ለዛም ነው ህጻናት ማውራት የሚማሩት ስለዚህ አዋቂዎች እንዲያቆሙ ይነግሯቸዋል።
S2E24c4-L2.back: That's why children learn to talk so adults tell them to stop.

S2E24c4-L21.mt: ስለዚህ ጉዳይ አሁን ማውራት አያስፈልገንም። ወደፊትም በጣም ሩቅ ነው።
S2E24c4-L21.back: We don't need to talk about it now, it's far away.

S2E24c4-L3.back: I have a question. It's not important.

S2E2c2-L17.mt: በ Bloomingdale ከጁሊ ጋር ልትገበያይ ነው? ይህም ራሔልን በቤተ ክርስቲያኗ ውስጥ እንደከዳት ነው።
S2E2c2-L17.back: Do you want to shop with Julie in Bloomingdale? That's like betraying Rachel in her church.

S2E2c2-L19.back: Monica, she'll kill you. She's very angry.

S2E2c2-L2.back: Yes, I don't remember which ones.

S2E2c2-L22.mt: ለእኔ አስፈላጊ ነው። ይህንን በጣም አደንቃለሁ።
S2E2c2-L22.back: It's important to me. I really appreciate this.

S2E2c2-L6.back: Thank you. She's a terrible woman.

S2E2c2-L7.mt: በ Bloomingdale ውስጥ ያለው ጓደኛዬ ነገ አቁሟል እና የሰራተኛ ቅናሹን መጠቀም ይፈልጋል። ከእኔ ጋር መምጣት የሚፈልግ አለ?
S2E2c2-L7.back: My friend in Bloomingdale is leaving tomorrow and wants to use the employee discount. Anyone want to come with me?

S2E2c2-L8.mt: አልችልም, አያቴን ወደ የእንስሳት ሐኪም ይዛችሁ መሄድ አለብኝ.
S2E2c2-L8.back: I can't, I have to take my grandpa to the vet.

S3E11c11-L10.back: That's right. That's what I said.

S3E11c11-L20.mt: ከፍ ያለ አንገትጌ እና የላላ ሱሪ ይልበሱ። ፕሮፌሽናል ይመስላሉ.
S3E11c11-L20.back: Wear a high neck and a wide shirt. They look professional.

S3E11c11-L24.mt: በጣም አመሰግናለሁ! አሁን እሷን ለማዘጋጀት ሊረዳቸው ነው. ከወንድ ጓደኛህ ሊወስድህ ይፈልጋል።
S3E11c11-L24.back: Thank you very much! Now help her to prepare. She wants to take you to your boyfriend.

S3E11c11-L26.mt: አብዷል? ይህ ማራኪ ሰው የሴት ጓደኛዬን ወደ ምሳ እየወሰደው ነው።
S3E11c11-L26.back: Is he full? This charming man is taking my girlfriend to lunch.

S3E11c11-L3.mt: አንተን ተመልከት። በዚህ ደስተኛ ነዎት ማለት ይቻላል።
S3E11c11-L3.back: Look at you. You're pretty happy with this.

S3E11c11-L31.mt: ከዚያ ስለራስዎ ማሰብዎን ያቁሙ! ትልቅ ሰው ሁን!
S3E11c11-L31.back: Then stop thinking about yourself! Be a big man!

S3E11c11-L4.mt: ከማርቆስ ጋር ባለመስራቱ በጣም አዝኛለሁ። ራሄል ላንቺ ጥሩ ነገር ብቻ ነው የምፈልገው።
S3E11c11-L4.back: I'm so sorry that you didn't work with Marcos. Rachel, I only want the best for you.

S3E11c11-L8.back: Did you give the house number?

S3E11c11-L9.mt: አዎን፣ እናም እሱን ብጠራው አትቸግረኝም፤ ምክንያቱም ለእኔ ጥሩ ነገር ትፈልጋለህ።
S3E11c11-L9.back: Yes, and don't bother me if I call him, because you want something good for me.

S3E12c1-L12.mt: ቁልፎችዎን ለማግኘት ረጅም ጊዜ ሊወስድዎት ይገባል።
S3E12c1-L12.back: It must take a long time to get your keys.

S3E12c1-L15.mt: አይ፣ ኤሊዎች ያስፈሩኛል። ዛሬ ያንን አያስፈልገኝም።
S3E12c1-L15.back: No, elves scare me. I don't need that today.

S3E12c1-L2.mt: አዎ፣ ግን አይጨነቁ። ጫማህን ማንም አይመለከትህም ምክንያቱም ያንን ፎጣ የሚመስል ቀሚስ ለብሰሃል።
S3E12c1-L2.back: Yeah, but don't worry. No one will look at your shoes because you're wearing that bag-like dress.

S3E12c1-L20.mt: አይደለም፣ ቦርሳ ነው። በውስጡ ቴርሞስ አለ.
S3E12c1-L20.back: No, it's a bag. It has a thermos inside.

S3E12c1-L24.mt: አልበርት ምንም ጓደኛ የለውም። የሚያገባ መስሎኝ የሚራቆተውን ለማየት ብቻ ነው።
S3E12c1-L24.back: Albert has no friends. I think he's marrying just to see what's going on.

S3E12c1-L25.mt: በባችለር ፓርቲ ላይ የሚራቆት ሰው ኦሪጅናል አይደለም። ለምን አስማተኛ አትቀጥርም?
S3E12c1-L25.back: The guy at the bachelorette party isn't original. Why don't you hire an assistant?

S3E12c1-L26.mt: አስማተኛው ቢራዬን በቡጢው ከከፈተ ምንም ችግር የለውም።
S3E12c1-L26.back: It's okay if the 10th opens my beer in the can.

S3E12c1-L4.mt: በአዲሱ ሥራዋ የመጀመሪያዋ ቀን ነው። በእሷ ላይ አትቀልድ!
S3E12c1-L4.back: The first day of her new job. Don't make fun of her!

S3E12c1-L5.mt: አንድ ቀን መጠበቅ እችላለሁ። አርብ ምን እየሰራህ ነው?
S3E12c1-L5.back: I can wait one day. What are you doing on Friday?

S3E12c1-L9.mt: ይህ ከዳይኖሰርስ ጋር ያለው ትስስር ነው?
S3E12c1-L9.back: Is this the association with dinosaurs?

S3E4c6-L10.back: You know what we feel now.

S3E4c6-L11.mt: ይህ አይስክሬም በጣም መጥፎ ጣዕም አለው።
S3E4c6-L11.back: This ice cream tastes really bad.

S3E4c6-L12.mt: ይህ ዝቅተኛ-ካሎሪ ነው፣ የወተት-ያልሆነ አኩሪ አተር አይስ ክሬም። በጣም ከባድ ለሆኑ ጉዳዮች እውነተኛውን አይስክሬም እናቆጥባለን.
S3E4c6-L12.back: This is a low-calorie, milk-free acorn ice cream. We save the real ice cream for the tough ones.

S3E4c6-L13.mt: ሰዎች ሁል ጊዜ መጥፎ ሲያደርጉህ ወደ ዝቅተኛ ቅባትነት ምግብ መቀየር አለብህ።
S3E4c6-L13.back: When people always make you feel bad, you should switch to low-fat food.

S3E4c6-L15.mt: ታዲያ የኔ ሁኔታ በጣም አሳሳቢ ነው ብለው አያስቡም?
S3E4c6-L15.back: So don't you think my situation is very worrying?

S3E4c6-L16.mt: አይ፣ የእርስዎ ሁኔታ በጣም አሳሳቢ አይደለም። ጉዳቱን መገደብ ብቻ ያስፈልግዎታል.
S3E4c6-L16.back: No, your condition is not very serious. You just need to limit the damage.

S3E4c6-L19.mt: ይህ አስፈላጊ ጊዜ ነው። እሷን መጥራት ከፈለግክ ጫማ ግዛ ወይም በምትኩ ገላህን ውሰድ። መልሷን ከፈለግክ፣ እንደማትጨነቅ አድርገህ መስራት አለብህ።
S3E4c6-L19.back: This is a crucial moment. If you want to call her, wear a shoe or take your rope instead. If you want her back, you have to act like you don't care.

S3E4c6-L2.mt: በመጨረሻ ደረስኩባት እና ግንኙነታችን በጣም በፍጥነት እየሄደ ነው እና ፍጥነት መቀነስ አለብን አለች ።
S3E4c6-L2.back: I finally got to her , and she said , " " Our relationship is going so fast , we need to slow down .

S3E4c6-L21.mt: እሷን ማግኘት እና ድንገተኛ አደጋ እንደሆነ ማስመሰል አለብህ። እንግዲያውስ ደንታ እንደሌለህ አድርጉ።
S3E4c6-L21.back: You have to find her and pretend it's an accident. So pretend you don't care.

S3E4c6-L5.mt: ከዚያም በጣም ጥገኛ እና ችግረኛ ሆንኩ።
S3E4c6-L5.back: Then I became very impoverished and destitute.

S1E16c15-L11.mt: እኔ እሷ ክፉ ነች እያልኩ አይደለም። እሷ ሁል ጊዜ እቃዬን ትሰብራለች። የስምንት ዓመት ልጅ ሳለሁ የካርቱን ቴርሞስዬን አልሰጣትም ነበር፣ ስለዚህ እሷ አውቶብስ ስር ወረወረችው። እውነተኛ አውቶቡስ። እና ከዚያም ራንዲ ብራውን ነበር. የቅርብ ጓደኛህ የሆነ የወንድ ጓደኛ አለህ?
S1E16c15-L11.back: I'm not saying she's evil. She always breaks my stuff. When I was seven years old, she didn't give me my cardboard thermos, so she threw it under the bus. Real bus. And then there was Randy Brown. Do you have a boyfriend who is your closest friend?

S1E16c15-L13.mt: ለእኔ የነበረው እሱ ነው። እሷም ሰረቀችው፣ ልቡንም ሰበረችው፣ ከዚያም ከእኔ ጋር ማውራት አቆመ። ሁለታችንም በሚመስል ነገር መቅረብ አልፈልግም አለ። እኛ መንታ ልጆች ነን።
S1E16c15-L13.back: She stole it, broke his heart, and then he stopped talking to me. He said he didn't want to get close to anything like us two. We are grandchildren.

S1E16c15-L15.mt: ጆይ የወንድ ጓደኛዬ፣ ወይም ቴርሞስዬ፣ ወይም ሌላ እንዳልሆነ አውቃለሁ፣ ግን...
S1E16c15-L15.back: I know Joey isn't my boyfriend, or my thermos, or anything, but...

S1E16c15-L21.mt: እባካችሁ፣ ለአንድ ሳምንት ያህል ተዋውቀዋል። እስካሁን አብረው እንኳን አልተኙም። ያ ከባድ አይደለም።
S1E16c15-L21.back: Please, get to know each other for about a week. They haven't even met yet. That's not hard.

S1E16c15-L25.back: Hello. Can we help you, lady?

S1E16c15-L3.mt: በጣም ጥሩ። ከስቴፕለር በስተቀር. ትንሽ ምክር: መቼም በዚያ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ከሆኑ, በጭራሽ, በጭራሽ እጅዎን አይተዉም ... በጠረጴዛው ላይ.
S1E16c15-L3.back: Very good except for the stapler. A little tip: if you're ever in that situation, never, never leave your hand... on the table.

S1E22c5-L16.mt: ሁሉም ሰው። በቀር... አይሆንም። ሁሉም ሰው።

S1E22c5-L18.mt: አትከፋ። በጣም ይወዱህ ነበር። ግን ከዚያ በኋላ አለቃ ሆንክ ፣ እና አሁን እርስዎ ሚስተር ቢግ አለቃ ነዎት። ሚስተር ቢንግ ቢግ አለቃ Bing
S1E22c5-L18.back: Don't be rude. They loved you very much. But then you became the boss, and now you are Mr. Big Boss. Mr. Bing Big Boss Bing

S1E22c5-L20.back: Yes. In fact, they appreciate your voice.

S1E22c5-L22.mt: ልክ እንደዚህ፡- 'ያ ሪፖርት ዘግይቶ ሊሆን ይችላል?'
S1E22c5-L22.back: Just like this: 'Could the report be late?'

S1E22c5-L30.mt: ያ SO አይደለም... ያ አይደለም... ኦህ ዝም በል!
S1E22c5-L30.back: That's not SO... that's not... oh, shut up!

S1E22c5-L4.mt: አዎ፣ ሰላም፣ አንድ ሰው ፔጅ አድርጎኛል። አይ፣ አንድሬ እዚህ የለም። ዛሬ ለሶስተኛ ጊዜ። አይ ጌታዬ ወሲብ አልሸጥም።
S1E22c5-L4.back: Yes, hello, someone made me a page. No, Andre is not here. For the third time today. No, my lord, I don't sell sex.

S1E22c5-L6.mt: ሰውየውን በ 55-JUMBO ይፈልጋሉ። ጃምቦ ፣ ልክ እንደ በጣም ትልቅ። እመኑኝ አትፈልጉኝም። ከእሱ ቁጥር ጋር ሲነጻጸር, እኔ በጣም ትንሽ ተስፋ አስቆራጭ እሆናለሁ. ባይ ባይ።
S1E22c5-L6.back: They want him in a 55-JUMBO. Jumbo, just like big. Believe me, you don't want me. Compared to his number, I'm a little bit disappointing.

S1E22c5-L9.mt: እነሆ ጫማዬን የሚለብሰውን ሰው ማወቅ ጥሩ ነው። እኔ.
S1E22c5-L9.back: Behold, it is better for me to know who wears my shoes.

S2E21c5-L11.mt: እሺ። ሶፋውን እንደ ውሻ ትጠራዋለህ, ከዚያም ሶፋውን እንደ ውሻ እንጠራዋለን, እና ወደ ማን እንደመጣ እናያለን.
S2E21c5-L11.back: Okay. You call the sofa a dog, then we call the sofa a dog, and we'll see who comes first.

S2E21c5-L19.back: Did you tell us as a little kid?

S2E21c5-L25.mt: ወደ ውጭ እንሂድ? ማነው እንደዚህ ያወራው?

S2E21c5-L26.back: That's what the one who wants to hit you says.

S2E21c5-L3.mt: በጣም የሚያብረቀርቁ እና አሪፍ ጃኬቶችን ለመልበስ ቤቶችን መሸጥ አለቦት?
S2E21c5-L3.back: Must sell houses to wear very shiny and cute jackets?

S2E21c5-L30.mt: ከዚያ ወደዚህ ቡና ቤት እንደገና ካልመጡ መዋጋት የለብዎትም። በጭራሽ።
S2E21c5-L30.back: Then don't fight if you don't come back to this cafe. Never.

S2E21c5-L31.mt: ሚስጥራዊ መሳሪያህን ጉንተርን በጣም ቀደም ብለህ የተጠቀምክ ይመስለኛል።
S2E21c5-L31.back: I think you used your secret tool Gunther a long time ago.

S2E21c5-L5.mt: ኧረ ይሄ ሰውዬ አይደለም ኮፍያሽን ይለብስ የነበረው?
S2E21c5-L5.back: Isn't this the guy who used to wear your hat?

S2E24c4-L12.mt: ደህና፣ አንዳንድ ጊዜ ልምዴን ስለመሸጥ አስባለሁ። ወደ ፈረንሳይ ልንሄድ እንችላለን... እና የፈረንሳይ ቶስት እንሰራለን።
S2E24c4-L12.back: Well, sometimes I think about selling my experience. We can go to France... and make French toast.

S2E24c4-L13.mt: እሺ፣ ፈረንሳይ ውስጥ ነን፣ ቶስት እየሰራን ነው። ጥግ ላይ ትንሽ የሕፃን አልጋ ታያለህ?
S2E24c4-L13.back: Okay, we're in France, we're making toast. You see the little baby bed in the corner?

S2E24c4-L15.back: Not a dog bed. A baby bed.

S2E24c4-L17.mt: ደህና፣ ህፃኑ ከውሻው ላይ መውደቁን የሚቀጥል ይመስለኛል። በወደፊታችን ልጆችን አታዩም?
S2E24c4-L17.back: Well, I think the baby continues to fall from the dog. Will you see children in the future?

S2E24c4-L2.mt: ታውቃለህ፣ ለዛም ነው ሕፃናት ማውራት የሚማሩት። ስለዚህ አዋቂዎች እንዲያቆሙት ሊነግሩ ይችላሉ.
S2E24c4-L2.back: You know, that's why children learn to talk, so adults can tell them to stop.

S2E24c4-L21.mt: ስለዚህ ጉዳይ አሁን ማውራት አያስፈልገንም። ይህ ወደፊት በጣም በጣም ሩቅ ነው። አለምን እየገዙ የሚበሩ መኪናዎች እና ጦጣዎች ማለቴ ነው።
S2E24c4-L21.back: We don't need to talk about it now, it's far, far in the future.

S2E24c4-L3.mt: አንድ ጥያቄ አለኝ። በጣም ትንሽ ጥያቄ። ምንም ግፊት የለም.
S2E24c4-L3.back: I have one question. A very small one. No pressure.

S2E24c4-L9.mt: አምላክ ሆይ፣ ዛሬ ማታ በአልጋ ላይ በጣም እድለኛ ትሆናለህ።
S2E24c4-L9.back: God, you will be very lucky in bed tonight.

S2E2c2-L17.mt: በ Bloomingdale ከጁሊ ጋር ልትገበያይ ነው? ያ ሱቅ እንደ ራሔል ቤተ ክርስቲያን ነው። ይህም በቤተክርስቲያኗ ውስጥ ራሔልን እንደማታለል ነው።
S2E2c2-L17.back: Do you want to shop with Julie at Bloomingdale? That shop is like Rachel's church, which is like deceiving Rachel in her church.

S2E2c2-L19.mt: ሞኒካ፣ ትገድልሃለች። መንገድ ላይ እንደ ውሻ ትገድልሃለች።
S2E2c2-L19.back: Monica, she'll kill you. She'll kill you like a dog on the road.

S2E2c2-L2.back: Yes. I don't remember how many. And I don't see them.

S2E2c2-L22.mt: ለእኔ ትልቅ ጉዳይ ነው። ይህ በጣም ጥሩ ነው, ሞኒካ. ይህንን በጣም አደንቃለሁ።
S2E2c2-L22.back: It's a big deal for me. This is very good, Monica. I really appreciate it.

S2E2c2-L7.mt: ስሙት። የ Bloomingdale ሱቅ ያለው ጓደኛዬ ነገ አቁሟል እና በተቻለ መጠን የሰራተኛ ቅናሽውን መጠቀም ይፈልጋል። ከእኔ ጋር መጥቶ መጠቀም የሚፈልግ ማነው?
S2E2c2-L7.back: Listen, my friend at Bloomingdale's is quitting tomorrow and wants to use the employee discount as much as possible. Who wants to come and use it with me?

S2E2c2-L8.mt: አልችልም። አያቴን ወደ የእንስሳት ሐኪም መውሰድ አለብኝ.
S2E2c2-L8.back: I can't. I have to take my grandpa to the vet.

S3E11c11-L10.mt: ትክክል ነው። ጥሩ ነገሮች. ይህን ነው ያልኩት።
S3E11c11-L10.back: That's right. Good things. That's what I meant.

S3E11c11-L18.mt: ደህና፣ ማርክን የማውቀው ከሆነ እና የማደርገው ይመስለኛል፣ ምንም ያነሰ ነገር አልጠበቅኩም።
S3E11c11-L18.back: Well, if I know Mark and I think I do, I didn't expect anything less.

S3E11c11-L2.mt: አይ. እንዴት ያለ አሰቃቂ አሰቃቂ አሳዛኝ ነገር ነው።
S3E11c11-L2.back: No. What a terrible, terrible, terrible thing.

S3E11c11-L24.back: 'Why don't you call him?' Well, thank you very much! Now he prepares her, the way a surgeon prepares a patient before cutting off his boyfriend!

S3E11c11-L26.mt: አብዷል? አዎ! እብድ ነኝ! አእምሮዬ እየጠፋኝ ነው! ይህ ቆንጆ ህልም ሰው የሴት ጓደኛዬን ወደ ምሳ እየወሰደው ነው!

S3E11c11-L31.mt: ከዚያ ስለራስዎ ብቻ ማሰብዎን ያቁሙ! ማደግ!
S3E11c11-L31.back: Then stop thinking only about yourself! Grow!

S3E11c11-L4.mt: አይ፣ ስለ ማርቆስ በእውነት አዝኛለሁ። ተመልከት ራሄል ላንቺ ጥሩ ነገር ብቻ ነው የምፈልገው።
S3E11c11-L4.back: No, I'm really sorry for Marcos. Look Rachel, I only want good things for you.

S3E11c11-L8.back: What, you gave the house number, the number of the house, where does he sleep?

S3E11c11-L9.mt: አዎን፣ እና እኔ ብጠራ ምንም ችግር የለህም፣ ምክንያቱም የምትፈልገው ለእኔ ጥሩ ነገር ብቻ ነው።
S3E11c11-L9.back: Yes, and you don't mind if I call you, because you only want good for me.

S3E12c1-L20.mt: አይደለም፣ ቦርሳ ነው። እና በውስጡ ቴርሞስ አለ.

S3E12c1-L24.back: Well, Albert doesn't have any friends, but he's very excited about the party. I think he's going to marry just to see the flames.

S3E12c1-L25.mt: በባችለር ፓርቲ ላይ ተራቂ? በጣም አሰልቺ። ለምን አስማተኛ አታገኝም?

S3E12c1-L26.back: Okay, if the lawyer opens my beer in the can, okay.

S3E12c1-L4.mt: በዚህ አዲስ ሥራ የመጀመሪያዋ ቀን ነው። ዛሬ አትሳለቅባት!

S3E4c6-L13.mt: ወንዶች ሁል ጊዜ ሲጎዱህ ዝቅተኛ ቅባት ወደሆነ አይስ ክሬም መቀየር አለብህ።
S3E4c6-L13.back: When men always hurt you, you should switch to low-fat ice cream.

S3E4c6-L2.back: So I finally grabbed her and she said our relationship is going very fast and we should slow down.

S3E4c6-L21.mt: ስለዚህ እሷን በአጋጣሚ ማግኘት አለብህ ነገር ግን ሆን ብለህ ነው። እና ከዚያ እርስዎ እንደማይጨነቁ ያድርጉት።

When I was eight years old, and I wasn't allowed to have my thermos Judy Jetson, so she was thrown under the bus. And then, oh, there was Randy Brown, who was like...

S3E4c6-L5.mt: Kisha nikawa tegemezi sana na mhitaji.
S3E4c6-L5.back: Then I became very destitute and poor.

S1E16c15-L11.mt: Sisemi kwamba yeye ni mwovu. Yeye huvunja vitu vyangu kila wakati. Nilipokuwa na umri wa miaka minane, sikumpa thermos yangu ya katuni, kwa hiyo akaitupa chini ya basi. Basi la kweli. Na kisha kulikuwa na Randy Brown. Umewahi kuwa na mpenzi ambaye alikuwa rafiki yako wa karibu?
S1E16c15-L11.back: I'm not saying he's evil. He breaks my stuff all the time. When I was eight, I didn't give him my cartoon thermos, so I threw it under the bus. The real bus. And then there was Randy Brown. Have you ever had a boyfriend who was your closest friend?

S1E16c15-L13.mt: Hivyo ndivyo alivyokuwa kwa ajili yangu. Na yeye alimuiba, na kuvunja moyo wake, na kisha akaacha kuzungumza nami. Alisema hataki kuwa karibu na kitu chochote kinachofanana na sisi sote. Sisi ni mapacha.
S1E16c15-L13.back: That’s how he was for me. And he stole, and broke his heart, and then stopped talking to me. He said he didn’t want to be close to anything that resembles us all. We are twins.

S1E16c15-L15.mt: Najua Joey si mpenzi wangu, au thermos yangu, au kitu chochote, lakini...
S1E16c15-L15.back: I know Joey is not my boyfriend, or my thermos, or anything, but...

S1E16c15-L21.mt: Oh tafadhali, wamekuwa wakichumbiana kwa wiki moja. Bado hawajalala pamoja. Hiyo si mbaya.
S1E16c15-L21.back: Oh please, they’ve been dating for a week. Still haven’t slept together. That’s not bad.

S1E16c15-L25.mt: Ndiyo. Habari. Je, tunaweza kukusaidia, bibie?
S1E16c15-L25.back: Yes. Hello. Can we help you, aunt?

S1E16c15-L3.mt: Vizuri sana. Isipokuwa kwa stapler. Ushauri mdogo: ikiwa umewahi katika hali hiyo, kamwe, usiache kamwe mkono wako ... kwenye dawati.
S1E16c15-L3.back: Very nice. Except for the stapler. Little advice: if you have ever been in that situation, never, never let go of your hand … on the desk.

S1E22c5-L16.mt: Kila mtu. Ila kwa... hapana. Kila mtu.

S1E22c5-L18.mt: Usijisikie vibaya. Walikuwa wakikupenda sana. Lakini basi ukawa bosi, na sasa wewe ni Bwana Big Boss. Bwana Bing. Bosi Mkubwa Bing.
S1E22c5-L18.back: Don't feel bad. They loved you so much. But then you became the boss, and now you're Mr. Big Boss. Mr. Bing. Big Boss Bing.

S1E22c5-L20.back: Yeah. They even listen to your voice.

S1E22c5-L22.mt: Kama hivi: 'Je, ripoti hiyo inaweza KUWA imechelewa zaidi?'
S1E22c5-L22.back: Like this: 'Could the report have been more late?'

S1E22c5-L26.mt: 'Je, vilima VINAWEZA KUWA na muziki tena?'

S1E22c5-L29.mt: Sawa, sisikii hivyo. Hiyo sio kweli.
S1E22c5-L29.back: Okay, I don't hear that. That's not true.

S1E22c5-L30.mt: Hiyo ni SO sio... Hiyo ni SO sio... Lo, nyamaza!
S1E22c5-L30.back: That's SO not... That's SO not...

S1E22c5-L4.mt: Ndiyo, hujambo, mtu alinipa ukurasa. Hapana, Andre hayupo. Mara ya tatu leo. Hapana, bwana. Siuzi ngono.
S1E22c5-L4.back: Yes, hello, someone gave me a page. No, Andre isn't there. Third time today. No, sir. I don't know sex.

S1E22c5-L6.mt: Unataka mwanamume mwenye umri wa miaka 55-JUMBO. Jumbo, kama kubwa sana. Niamini, hunitaki. Ikilinganishwa na idadi yake, ningekuwa tamaa ndogo sana. Kwaheri.
S1E22c5-L6.back: You want a 55-year-old man-JUMBO. Jumbo, as big as it is. Believe me, you want it. Compared to its size, I would be very despairing. Goodbye.

S1E22c5-L9.mt: Tazama, ni vizuri kumjua mtu ambaye huvaa viatu vyangu. Mimi.
S1E22c5-L9.back: Behold, it is good to know a man who wears my shoes.

S2E21c5-L11.mt: Sawa. Unaita kitanda kama mbwa, kisha tunaita kitanda kama mbwa, na tunaona nani anakuja.
S2E21c5-L11.back: Okay. You call a bed like a dog, then we call a bed like a dog, and we see who comes.

S2E21c5-L19.back: He told us, as a young child?

S2E21c5-L22.back: Do not play with his idols.

S2E21c5-L26.mt: Mwanamume ambaye anakaribia kukupiga huzungumza hivyo.
S2E21c5-L26.back: A man who is about to hit you speaks like that.

S2E21c5-L3.mt: Je, ni lazima uuze nyumba ili uvae zile jaketi zinazong'aa na baridi kwelikweli?
S2E21c5-L3.back: Do you have to sell your house to wear those shiny, really cold jackets?

S2E21c5-L30.mt: Basi huna haja ya kupigana, ikiwa hutakuja tena kwenye nyumba hii ya kahawa. Kamwe.
S2E21c5-L30.back: So you don't have to fight, if you don't come to this coffee house again. Never.

S2E21c5-L31.mt: Nadhani ulitumia silaha yako ya siri, Gunther, mapema sana.
S2E21c5-L31.back: I think you used your secret weapon, Gunther, too early.

S2E21c5-L5.mt: Huyo, si yule jamaa aliyekuwa anavaa kofia yako?
S2E21c5-L5.back: Isn't that the guy wearing your hat?

S2E24c4-L12.mt: Naam, wakati mwingine mimi hufikiria kuhusu kuuza mazoezi yangu. Tunaweza kuhamia Ufaransa ... na kutengeneza toast ya Kifaransa.
S2E24c4-L12.back: Well, sometimes I think about selling my practice. We could move to France … and make French toast.

S2E24c4-L13.mt: Sawa, kwa hivyo tuko Ufaransa, tunatengeneza toast. Je! unaona kitanda kidogo cha mtoto kwenye kona?
S2E24c4-L13.back: Okay, so we're in France, we're making toast. Do you see a little baby bed in the corner?

S2E24c4-L15.mt: Si kitanda cha mbwa. Kitanda kwa mtoto mchanga.
S2E24c4-L15.back: Not a dog bed. A bed for a toddler.

S2E24c4-L17.mt: Vema, nadhani mtoto angeendelea kuanguka kutoka kwa mbwa. Je... huoni watoto katika siku zetu zijazo?
S2E24c4-L17.back: Well, I think the child would continue to fall from the dog. Do you... do not see children in our future?

S2E24c4-L2.mt: Unajua, hiyo labda ndiyo sababu watoto wachanga hujifunza kuzungumza. Kwa hiyo wanaweza kuwaambia watu wazima kuacha.
S2E24c4-L2.back: You know, that’s maybe why babies learn to talk. So they can tell adults to stop.

S2E24c4-L21.mt: Hatuhitaji kuzungumzia hili sasa. Hii ni mbali sana katika siku zijazo. Ninamaanisha magari ya kuruka na nyani wanaotawala ulimwengu.
S2E24c4-L21.back: We don’t need to talk about this now. This is far into the future. I mean flying cars and apes ruling the world.

S2E24c4-L3.mt: Nina swali kwako. Swali dogo sana. Hakuna shinikizo.
S2E24c4-L3.back: I have a question for you. A very short question. No pressure.

S2E24c4-L9.mt: Ee Mungu, usiku wa leo utakuwa na bahati sana kitandani.
S2E24c4-L9.back: Oh God, you'll be very lucky in bed tonight.

S2E2c2-L12.mt: Hujambo, keki yangu ndogo ya sukari.

S2E2c2-L17.mt: Je, unaenda kufanya ununuzi na Julie katika Bloomingdale's? Hifadhi hiyo ni kama kanisa la Raheli. Hiyo ni kama kumdanganya Raheli ndani ya kanisa lake.
S2E2c2-L17.back: Are you going shopping with Julie at Bloomingdale's? That store is like Rachel's church. That's like deceiving Rachel into her church.

S2E2c2-L19.mt: Monica, atakuua. Atakuua kama mbwa mtaani.
S2E2c2-L19.back: Monica, he'll kill you, he'll kill you like a dog.

S2E2c2-L2.back: Yeah. I don't remember which ones. And I won't look.

S2E2c2-L22.mt: Ni jambo kubwa kwangu. Hii ni nzuri, Monica. Ninashukuru sana hii.
S2E2c2-L22.back: It’s a big deal for me. This is great, Monica. I really appreciate this.

S2E2c2-L7.mt: Sikiliza. Rafiki yangu katika duka la Bloomingdale anaacha kazi kesho na anataka kutumia punguzo la wafanyakazi wake kadri awezavyo. Nani anataka kuja na mimi na kuitumia?
S2E2c2-L7.back: Listen. My friend at Bloomingdale's is quitting tomorrow and wants to use her employee discount as much as she can. Who wants to come with me and use it?

S2E2c2-L8.mt: siwezi. Lazima nimpeleke bibi yangu kwa daktari wa wanyama.
S2E2c2-L8.back: I can't. I have to send my aunt to the vet.

S3E11c11-L10.mt: Hiyo ni kweli. Mambo mazuri. Ndivyo nilivyosema.
S3E11c11-L10.back: That's true. Good things. That's what I said.

S3E11c11-L18.mt: Vema, kama namjua Mark, na nadhani namjua, sikutarajia chochote kidogo.
S3E11c11-L18.back: Well, as I know Mark, and I think I do, I didn’t expect anything at all.

S3E11c11-L2.mt: Oh hapana. Ni msiba mbaya sana, mbaya sana.
S3E11c11-L2.back: Oh no. It's a very, very bad tragedy.

S3E11c11-L20.mt: Kola ndefu na suruali kubwa iliyolegea husema 'Mimi ni mtaalamu', si 'mimi ni mrembo'.
S3E11c11-L20.back: A long collar and large flared trousers say 'I'm a professional', not 'I'm pretty'.

S3E11c11-L24.mt: 'Kwa nini humwiti?' Naam, asante sana! Sasa atamtayarisha, jinsi daktari wa upasuaji anavyomtayarisha mgonjwa kabla ya kumkata mpenzi!
S3E11c11-L24.back: 'Why do you rape her?' Yes, thank you very much! Now he will prepare her, as a surgeon prepares a patient before cutting his lover!

S3E11c11-L26.mt: Je, mimi ni wazimu? Ndiyo! Nina kichaa! Ninapoteza akili! Mtu huyu mzuri wa ndoto anachukua mpenzi wangu kwa chakula cha mchana!
S3E11c11-L26.back: Am I crazy? Yes! I’m crazy! I’m losing my mind! This beautiful dream guy is taking my boyfriend for lunch!

S3E11c11-L3.mt: Ndiyo, sawa. Angalia wewe. Unakaribia kucheza kwa furaha.
S3E11c11-L3.back: Yeah, right. Look at you. You’re about to play for fun.

S3E11c11-L31.mt: Basi acha kujifikiria wewe tu! Kua juu!
S3E11c11-L31.back: So leave your thoughts alone, rise up!

S3E11c11-L4.mt: La, ninasikitika sana kuhusu Mark. Tazama, Raheli, nakutakia mema tu.
S3E11c11-L4.back: No, I am very sorry about Mark. Behold, Rachel, I wish you all the best.

S3E11c11-L8.mt: Je, alikupa nambari yake ya nyumbani? Namba ya NYUMBANI kwake? ANALALA wapi?
S3E11c11-L8.back: Did he give you his home number? His BUSINESS number? Where does he sleep?

S3E11c11-L9.mt: Ndio, wala hamjali nikiita, kwa sababu mnanitakia mema tu.
S3E11c11-L9.back: Yes, you do not care if I call, because you wish me only good.

S3E12c1-L12.mt: Ni lazima ikuchukue saa ili kupata funguo zako humo.
S3E12c1-L12.back: It must take you a while to find your keys in it.

S3E12c1-L15.mt: Hapana, hakuna kasa. Kasa wananitisha. Sio leo.
S3E12c1-L15.back: No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no.

S3E12c1-L2.mt: Oh ndiyo. Lakini usijali. Hakuna mtu atakayeangalia viatu, kwa sababu kila mtu ataangalia mavazi yako ya kitambaa.
S3E12c1-L2.back: Oh yes. But don’t worry. No one will look at your shoes, because everyone will look at your clothes.

S3E12c1-L20.mt: Hapana, ni mkoba. Na kuna thermos ndani yake.
S3E12c1-L20.back: No, it’s a purse. And there’s a thermos in it.

S3E12c1-L24.mt: Naam, Albert hana marafiki. Lakini anakifurahia sana chama. Nadhani sababu pekee ya yeye kuolewa ni kuona stripper.
S3E12c1-L24.back: Well, Albert has no friends. But he really enjoys the party. I think the only reason he married is to see a stripper.

S3E12c1-L25.mt: Mvuvi nguo kwenye karamu ya watoto wadogo? Hivyo boring. Kwa nini usipate mchawi?
S3E12c1-L25.back: Fisherman clothes at the feast of toddlers? So boring. Why not get a wizard?

S3E12c1-L26.mt: Vema, ikiwa mchawi anaweza kufungua bia yangu kwa kitako chake, basi sawa.
S3E12c1-L26.back: Well, if the sorcerer can open my beer with his staff, then fine.

S3E12c1-L4.mt: Ni siku yake ya kwanza katika kazi hii mpya. Usimtanie leo!
S3E12c1-L4.back: It's his first day in this new job. Don't blame him today!

S3E12c1-L5.mt: Sawa, naweza kusubiri hadi kesho. Halo, unafanya nini Ijumaa?
S3E12c1-L5.back: Okay, I can wait until tomorrow. Hello, what are you doing on Friday?

S3E12c1-L9.mt: Ndiyo. Na hiyo ni tai yenye dinosaurs juu yake?
S3E12c1-L9.back: Yes. And that's an eagle with dinosaurs on it?

S3E4c6-L10.mt: Karibu katika upande wetu wa handaki lenye giza.
S3E4c6-L10.back: Come on our side of the dark tunnel.

S3E4c6-L11.mt: Aiskrimu hii ina ladha ya takataka.
S3E4c6-L11.back: This ice cream tastes like trash.

S3E4c6-L12.mt: Hiyo ni takataka ya soya isiyo na mafuta kidogo. Tunaokoa ice cream halisi kwa kesi za mwisho kabisa, wagonjwa wanaokufa.
S3E4c6-L12.back: That’s low-fat soy waste. We save real ice cream for the very last case, dying patients.

S3E4c6-L13.mt: Wanaume wanapokuumiza kila wakati, huna budi kubadili aiskrimu isiyo na mafuta kidogo.
S3E4c6-L13.back: When men hurt you all the time, you have to change to low-fat ice cream.

S3E4c6-L15.mt: Kwa hivyo hufikirii mimi ni wa mwisho? Si kufa?
S3E4c6-L15.back: So don't you think I'm the last? Not dying?

S3E4c6-L16.mt: Hapana, wewe si wastaafu. Unahitaji tu matibabu ya dharura.
S3E4c6-L16.back: No, you are not retired. You only need emergency treatment.

S3E4c6-L19.mt: Huu ni wakati muhimu. Ikiwa unahisi mkono wako unafikia simu hiyo, unaenda kununua viatu, unaingia kwenye bafu ya Bubble. Ikiwa unataka arudishwe, lazima ufanye kama haujali.
S3E4c6-L19.back: This is a crucial moment. If you feel your hand reaches that phone, you go buy shoes, you enter the Bubble Bath. If you want him back, you have to do as if you don’t care.

S3E4c6-L2.mt: Kwa hivyo hatimaye nilimshika, na anasema uhusiano wetu unaenda haraka sana na inabidi tupunguze kasi.
S3E4c6-L2.back: So I finally caught him, and he says our relationship is going too fast and we need to slow down.

S3E4c6-L21.mt: Kwa hivyo ni lazima ukutane naye kwa bahati mbaya, lakini kwa makusudi. Na kisha fanya kama hujali.
S3E4c6-L21.back: So you have to meet him by accident, but on purpose. And then act as if you don't care.

S3E4c6-L23.back: O lover, you are not sorrowful at all.

S3E4c6-L24.back: I asked if I would lose him.

S3E4c6-L5.mt: Kisha nikawa mhitaji na mshikaji, kama mtoto wa mbwa mwenye huzuni.
S3E4c6-L5.back: Then I became needy and destitute, like a sad dog's child.
